pages.title: Playdough School
pages.creator: Jogada
pages.description:
Playdough School takes place after modeling clay in the teachers' coffee turns the staff into clay zombies. Explore a handmade Brazilian school and use unusual tools, including a slingshot, chalk launcher, sanitizer, and a large clay-ball launcher, to cure the teachers. The stop-motion appearance carries through the school's clay setting.

Story mode includes quests and a large boss, with a surrounding neighborhood available to explore. A dog can accompany you, and other activities include assembling a giant robot from junkyard parts and racing karts. Online play also lets you join friends in the school's adventure.

pages.title: Mars Invasion
pages.creator: Kasama Koubou
pages.description:
Mars Invasion is a real-time strategy game about establishing and defending a base on Mars. Construct power plants and mining facilities to support your operation, then protect it with walls, turrets, and trained squads. Alien insects emerge from the sand, forcing you to balance building with active defense.

Explore the dark areas of the map to locate nests and destroy them rather than only waiting for the next swarm. Research opens additional technology, including laser towers, cannons, and demolition troops. Eight stages develop from a training area into a final assault, adding more demanding threats to your expanding base.

pages.title: Virtual Neko Kitty Collector
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Feed the cats in Virtual Neko Kitty Collector and buy items for their yard. Earn red hearts as you care for the kittens, then put those hearts toward yard upgrades. Try different items as you build up the space around your cats.

pages.title: Sudoku - Pin.Games
pages.creator: Pin Games
pages.description: Fill a nine-by-nine board in Sudoku - Pin.Games. Each row, column, and three-by-three box must contain the digits one through nine once each. Pick from six difficulties, try a daily puzzle, or use a hint when the remaining numbers are hard to place.

pages.title: Apocalypse Shelter
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Build a base and recruit fighters in Apocalypse Shelter. Manage resources to expand the shelter, then take your squad into turn-based battles. Open chests for new heroes and upgrade their cards as you learn which abilities work well together.

pages.title: Parking Driver
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Practice parallel and reverse parking in Parking Driver. Steer around obstacles and line up each approach before pulling into the space. Try to park cleanly in less time as the layouts get harder, and unlock other cars along the way.

pages.title: Queens Royal: Sudoku Puzzle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Place queens in Queens Royal: Sudoku Puzzle so every row, column, and colored region gets one. Check which positions would let queens attack one another before you commit to a square. Work through the levels or switch to the daily and endless challenges.

pages.title: Tile Match Cafe
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Collect three identical tiles at a time in Tile Match Cafe. Look at which pieces are accessible before you start a set, then use the space each match opens up. Try a power-up when the layout makes the next group hard to complete.

pages.title: Travel With Me: ASMR Edition
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Style travel vlogger Lisa for different stops in Travel With Me: ASMR Edition. Choose clothes for temples in Thailand, the desert in Dubai, or the beaches of the Maldives. Change the outfit as the setting changes and put together a look for each part of the trip.

pages.title: Sprunki Quiz
pages.creator: AF
pages.description: Match characters such as Simon, Oren, and Raddy with their names in Sprunki Quiz. In one mode you read a name and choose a picture. In the other, you see the character first and have to pick the right name.

pages.title: Block Pixels
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Place colorful shapes to clear lines in Block Pixels. The colors you remove also contribute to a hidden pixel-art picture. Look for placements that clear the colors you need while leaving room for the next pieces, then see which image comes into view.

pages.title: Save My Pet
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Draw a barrier between the pet and the bees in Save My Pet. Think about where the line will rest when the swarm reaches it. The shelter has to hold for several seconds, so change the shape if the bees can push through or get around it.

pages.title: Squid Escape Game
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide both blue prisoners out of the maze in Squid Escape Game. Pick up every geometric shape and find the two keys before heading to the door. Avoid the spikes and keep the characters close together as they work through the prison.

pages.title: Cyberpunk: Corporation
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Help residents resist the company taking over their city in Cyberpunk: Corporation. Complete local tasks to gain support, then activate the robot and use it to break through the defenses. The goal is to free the city from the corporation's control.

pages.title: Lady Pool
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Put together a comic-book antihero look in Lady Pool. Try a superhero jumpsuit, mix bright colors and prints, and pick a hat or accessory that suits the character. Change the individual pieces to see how far you can take the costume.

pages.title: Bang Bang Mahjong
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Slide tiles into matching positions in Bang Bang Mahjong. Look for ways to bring identical pieces together without blocking later moves. Use a shuffle, removal, or hint when you get stuck, and keep matching until the board is clear.

pages.title: Black Hole: Beauty Makeup
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Steer a black hole around the scene in Black Hole: Beauty Makeup. Swallow objects to grow and see what else fits as the hole gets bigger. The collection phase leads into a beauty makeover, and you can unlock different skins as you play.

pages.title: Soccer Euro Cup 2025
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Choose a country to represent in Soccer Euro Cup 2025. Kick or head the ball toward the other goal and try to get past the opposing player. Watch the ball's height before moving in so you can choose the right kind of shot.

pages.title: Zombie Redemption
pages.creator: UznGames
pages.description: Survive a failed experiment's aftermath in Zombie Redemption. Fight off zombies and earn gold as you take them down. Spend it to unlock stronger weapons, then put them to use when another group of zombies comes after you.

pages.title: GT Cars City Racing
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Take a stylized sports car into an open Toy City in GT Cars City Racing. Explore the streets and look for places to perform stunts. Try different cars and see how each handles when you move from a stretch of road to a stunt.

pages.title: Words from Words
pages.creator: Wit Games
pages.description: Build as many words as you can from the given letters in Words from Words. Click letters in order to submit a common noun. Use a word's definition to check a new find, then rearrange the letters to look for more possibilities.

pages.title: Snake King
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Eat apples to grow in Snake King. The longer the snake gets, the more of the arena its tail occupies. Plan each turn so you can reach the next apple without running into a wall or your own tail.

pages.title: Traffic Escape Puzzle
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Work out the order in which cars should move in Traffic Escape Puzzle. Send one vehicle out when it has room to go, then check what that move opens for the others. Clear the traffic maze without causing a collision.

pages.title: Head Basketball
pages.creator: GM - Good Media
pages.description: Move with the arrow keys and throw with Z or X in Head Basketball. Each basket earns two points. Look for a clear shot at the other hoop while keeping track of the clock and the score you need to beat.

pages.title: Portals
pages.creator: KTV
pages.description: Help a black and a white hero find their way home in Portals. Switch between them and use their abilities to get through each puzzle. Both characters must reach a portal of their own color to finish the level.

pages.title: Bell Madness
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Pester a cartoon neighbor in Bell Madness by ringing the bell, tapping the window, or shaking the mailbox. Watch for a different reaction as you try each prank. Spend the coins you earn on doorbells with new sounds or on hints for reactions you have yet to see.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect Gold
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Pair identical tiles in Mahjong Connect Gold. A match clears only when the route between the two tiles takes no more than three straight segments. Use the gaps left by earlier pairs to open routes through the rest of the board.

pages.title: 3D Ball Balancer
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Roll a ball along a bridge suspended in the air in 3D Ball Balancer. Steer around gaps and control your speed over ramps and narrow planks. Slow down when a small mistake could send the ball off the edge.

pages.title: Jewelry Idle
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Run a jewelry shop in Jewelry Idle. Make pieces to sell and build up the store as customers arrive. Move around with WASD or the arrow keys as you keep the business supplied and work on its next improvement.

pages.title: King Of The Hill
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Race a pixel-art car to the top of a mountain in King Of The Hill. Watch for obstacles as the road climbs and keep the car intact as you compete for first place. Try another car when you want to take on the climb again.

pages.title: Infinite Blocks
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Defend your base in Infinite Blocks by firing into advancing rows. Pick where to aim before the blocks move closer and clear the lines that threaten your position. Keep firing and see how long you can hold out.

pages.title: Smile Cube
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Tap groups of two or more matching cubes in Smile Cube. Clear the whole board for a bonus, since cubes left behind turn to stone. Think about which groups will still be available after a clear and build your score across five stages.

pages.title: Kitty Jewel Quest
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Line up matching cats in Kitty Jewel Quest before time runs out. Clear three or more of the same type in a row or column to work toward the stage goal. Earn coins from missions and events, then use them to buy boosters.

pages.title: Car Out
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Free a trapped car from a crowded lot in Car Out. Click cars to move them and look for the one that blocks the next useful move. Work through the traffic jam until the car has a clear route out.

pages.title: Car Stunt Races Mega Ramps
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive across ten stunt courses in Car Stunt Races Mega Ramps. Use WASD or the arrows to keep the car lined up as you approach a ramp. The levels have no timer, so take the time you need to steady the car before a tricky section.

pages.title: Storm Tower Defense - Idle Pixel War
pages.creator: ncsupergame
pages.description: Build up a defensive spire in Storm Tower Defense - Idle Pixel War. Upgrade different tower attributes to shape how it handles incoming enemies. Use the idle progression to strengthen the spire as you take on the survival challenges.

pages.title: Rope Collect Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Collect yarn as you run in Rope Collect Rush. Steer Rope-Man around rolling gears and spinning bars, which cut down the rope you have gathered. Keep enough yarn as you head for the treasure chest at the end of the course.

pages.title: Cinderella Dress Up Girl Games
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Dress Cinderella for the ball in Cinderella Dress Up Girl Games. Choose her clothes, hairstyle, and accessories before she goes to meet Prince Charming. Compare the pieces together and change what you like until the outfit is ready for the occasion.

pages.title: Startup Fever
pages.creator: Devshifu Studio
pages.description: Start a paper business in Startup Fever and hire workers to take on projects. Collect cash, upgrade machines, and open more of the office as production grows. Expand into IT and logistics and keep your team working as you find more ways to earn.

pages.title: Astro Race
pages.creator: Exodragon
pages.description: Race a spaceship against other pilots in Astro Race. Drift along the track border to pick up speed and recharge your boost, then use it to make a pass. Earn gold and move up the leagues to take on faster competition.

pages.title: Halloween Clown Dressup
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shop for costume pieces in Halloween Clown Dressup, then use them to make over the clown and its belongings. The finished design earns coins based on the items you used. Save the look when you are happy with the result.

pages.title: Wo-Miners
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Collect cotton from the ground in Wo-Miners and trade it for clothes. Explore the map to find the shops and the cotton they require. Work through the trades so the guardians will let you into the castle.

pages.title: Fun Memory Training
pages.creator: TWO PLAYERS GAME STUDIO
pages.description: Watch the candies light up in Fun Memory Training and repeat the order you saw. Remember the whole sequence before entering it, especially when the pattern changes. The game generates 25 levels to keep the next sequence unpredictable.

pages.title: Cyclomaniacs
pages.creator: TurboNuke
pages.description: Race bicycles and perform stunts in Cyclomaniacs. Start with a robot rider and balance the bike in the air to land flips and fill your boost meter. Finish races and meet achievement targets to unlock more riders and features.

pages.title: Find the School Bag
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Search for a missing school bag in Find the School Bag. Click through the scene and look for objects or clues that help with the puzzles. Recheck places you have visited when you find something that could open another part of the search.

pages.title: Into Space
pages.creator: Barbarian Games
pages.description: Launch a rocket and try to reach space in as few days as possible in Into Space. Steer around objects and slow down before an unavoidable impact to reduce damage. Switch the engine off briefly if you need to coast and save fuel.

pages.title: Parking Harder
pages.creator: tegagame.com
pages.description: Use the arrow keys to guide the car into its space in Parking Harder. Make small corrections when the route narrows, since a mistake can send you back to the start. Line up the final approach before moving into the bay.

pages.title: Reach the Platform
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Launch a circle toward round platforms in Reach the Platform. Press once to lock the direction of the rotating arrow, then press again to release. Watch the power gauge before that second press, especially when the target is small.

pages.title: Merge Defense
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Build turrets and combine matching ones in Merge Defense. A merge raises the turret's level and gives you a stronger defense against the attackers. Check what you can upgrade before the next wave reaches your home.

pages.title: Math Game Multiple Choice
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Choose the correct answer from four options in Math Game Multiple Choice. Each arithmetic question has a time limit and earns one point when answered correctly. A mistake or an expired timer ends the run, so work quickly as the questions get harder.

pages.title: Falling Ball
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Guide a falling ball between platforms in Falling Ball. Look at the next target and line the ball up before it drops past the landing. Keep making the jumps without missing too many platforms, since repeated falls end the run.

pages.title: Ski King
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Ski down mountain slopes in Ski King and look for the quickest route. Weave past trees and rocks, and adjust your turns when the snow turns icy. Finish each descent and try to improve your time on the next run.

pages.title: Mirror Light
pages.creator: Playmous
pages.description: Aim and fire at mirrors in Mirror Light. Use the reflections to send the beam toward the battery and charge it. Trace where the light will go after each bounce so you can line up a route through the level.

pages.title: Tower Defense
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Protect the kingdom from monster waves in Tower Defense. Build towers while you still have time to cover the routes, then watch what gets through. Use elemental attacks when arrows and stones are not enough to stop the next group.

pages.title: Happy Fishing
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Drop the hook when a fish is within reach in Happy Fishing. Watch what is swimming under the boat before you click. Time the cast so you bring up a fish instead of catching a bomb.

pages.title: Xmas Math
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Pick the missing arithmetic sign in Xmas Math. Check whether addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division makes the displayed result correct. Answer as many equations as you can in sixty seconds.

pages.title: Idle Airline Tycoon
pages.creator: Fish Pond Studio
pages.description: Open routes between cities in Idle Airline Tycoon. Pick planes from a fleet of 25 types and upgrade airports to attract more passengers. Your airline can earn money while you are away, and an optional prestige system lets you take the business into a new stage.

pages.title: Warrior Monster
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Swipe to slash monsters in Warrior Monster and keep them away from the kingdom. Watch which enemies are within reach and move your swipe through their path. Keep clearing the attackers as they come in.

pages.title: Concept Car Stunt
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Drive one of four concept cars in Concept Car Stunt. Explore the stunt area for hidden Hit Coins and spend them on other cars. Use nitro on an open stretch and the handbrake when you need to turn before the next obstacle.

pages.title: Dino Party Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Put together twelve pictures from a dinosaur birthday party in Dino Party Jigsaw. Look for parts of the dinosaurs, decorations, and scenery that continue across the piece edges. Build each scene until the whole celebration comes into view.

pages.title: Enemy Aircrafts
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Defend your territory with a tank in Enemy Aircrafts. Move to avoid bombs from hostile planes and pick up the supplies dropped by friendly cargo aircraft. Keep the tank going for as long as you can while watching what is falling from above.

pages.title: Sky Train Simulator : Elevated Train Driving Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Drive an elevated train above the city in Sky Train Simulator : Elevated Train Driving Game. Follow the raised tracks and stop at stations to carry passengers between them. Watch your approach to each stop as the train travels above road traffic.

pages.title: Robot Ring Fighting Wrestling Games
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Take a robot into the ring in Robot Ring Fighting Wrestling Games. Use Z, X, C, and V for the fight controls and look for openings to land punches. Work toward knocking out the opposing robot in the championship.

pages.title: Multi Levels Car Parking Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Guide a car into the parking area in Multi Levels Car Parking Game. Slow down before turns and use the space around the car to straighten your approach. Work through the parking challenges and get used to judging the car's clearance.

pages.title: City Cycle Rickshaw Simulator 2020
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Pick up passengers on a bicycle rickshaw in City Cycle Rickshaw Simulator 2020. Ride through traffic and drop them off where they ask to go. Earn money from fares and use it to unlock other rickshaws and drivers.

pages.title: Farm Animals Dash
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Find matching animals in Farm Animals Dash. Work through the matches as the game shows you which character to look for. After ten successful matches, the target changes, so check the new animal before choosing again.

pages.title: Epic Race 3D
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Race through obstacles in Epic Race 3D. Tap to control the runner and judge when it is safe to move through each hazard. Stay on the course and try to reach the finish before the other racers.

pages.title: Reckless Roller Fun Park
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Control the roller coaster in Reckless Roller Fun Park and carry riders to the end. Use the mouse to change speed when the track calls for it. Slow down before a difficult section so the ride can continue without crashing.

pages.title: Domino Clash
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Set off a chain of falling dominoes in Domino Clash. Use the mouse to start the action and watch how the impact travels through the layout. Look for a way to keep the chain going when the next pieces are spaced differently.

pages.title: Love is... Sweet Valentine Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble Valentine illustrations in Love is... Sweet Valentine Puzzle. Choose from six pictures and work with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the characters and background details to find pieces that connect.

pages.title: Zig Zag Switch
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Guide the piece along a zigzag path in Zig Zag Switch. Click or tap to change direction and watch which cubes are in the way. Stay on the route and avoid the obstacles you cannot touch.

pages.title: Jelly Sugar Rush
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Drag through matching jellies in Jelly Sugar Rush. Connect three or more of the same kind to clear the chain. Look for neighboring pieces that can extend your match, then scan the board again when the layout changes.

pages.title: Counter City Strike Commando Action 2020
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Take on city combat missions in Counter City Strike Commando Action 2020. Move around roads and buildings and use the mouse to fire at enemies. Work through the objectives and watch for threats as you move to a new position.

pages.title: Xtreme Offroad Jeep 2019
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Drive a jeep off-road in Xtreme Offroad Jeep 2019. Try the timed checkpoint missions when you want to race the clock, or use Free Ride to explore the terrain. Steer with WASD and adjust your speed for the rougher stretches.

pages.title: Pinball.VS
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Play one-on-one pinball battles in Pinball.VS. Knock down the opposing side's pieces and adjust your shots when the kickoff or formation changes. Work through different themed boards and unlock upgrades through wins.

pages.title: Death Alley
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Stop zombies from getting past you in Death Alley. Swing a chain at the undead as they come into range and watch where the next group is approaching. Keep clearing enemies to hold your position in the alley.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Learn Animals
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Join Hazel and her classmates in Baby Hazel Learn Animals. Help them solve quizzes and puzzles about what animals and birds eat, where they live, and what they produce. Work through the classroom assignments as the group learns about different species.

pages.title: Ultimate Knife Up
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Time knife throws in Ultimate Knife Up. Watch the target turn and pick an open spot before you throw the next knife. Keep the throws going as you try to land more without striking one already in the target.

pages.title: House Paint
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Swipe a paint block across the walls in House Paint. Cover every white space to finish the level. Look at where each swipe will stop and use the edges of the wall to reach any spots you missed.

pages.title: EG Panda Escape
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Guide three pandas out of the maze in EG Panda Escape. Collect red and blue keys to open locks and avoid moving saws and bombs. Move rocks into place to block a saw or destroy a bomb before the pandas try to pass.

pages.title: Boys & Girls Bubble Pop
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Pop water balloons to trigger a chain reaction in Boys & Girls Bubble Pop. Choose a balloon whose splash can reach others and keep the reaction going until the level is clear. Work through 400 layouts and aim for three stars on each.

pages.title: Light it up Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Light up neon shapes in Light it up Online by jumping the stickman from one to another. Use swings, flips, and slides to get between shapes. Look at where the next landing is before you leave the current surface.

pages.title: Old West Shootout
pages.creator: Genetic Studio
pages.description: Shoot bandits and save hostages in Old West Shootout. Check who is in your sights before you fire, then look for the next outlaw. Earn cash to collect up to ten guns and try their different effects.

pages.title: EG Rpg Fight
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Take on quests and fight enemies in EG Rpg Fight. Equip weapons and learn skills as your character develops. Use attacks, magic, or a dodge roll when the fight calls for it, then collect equipment and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Mahjong Master 2
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Clear stacked layouts in Mahjong Master 2 by pairing identical tiles. Work from the exposed pieces and look for matches that uncover more of the pyramid. Pair tiles quickly to earn bonus points as you try for the golden stars.

pages.title: Realistic Buggy Driver
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a buggy and explore different environments in Realistic Buggy Driver. Drive across the 3D terrain and see how the vehicle handles when the surface changes. Switch to another buggy or location when you want a different route.

pages.title: Baby Audrey Appendectomy
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Audrey through a hospital visit in Baby Audrey Appendectomy. Check her temperature and heartbeat, then follow the prompts to examine her with the scanner. Use the instruments the game gives you to work through the operation and finish her treatment.

pages.title: Silent Insanity PT: Psychological Trauma
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Solve puzzles and survive 17 levels in Silent Insanity PT: Psychological Trauma. Explore the dark surroundings and pay attention to details that could help you advance. Work out what each area asks of you as the horror builds around you.

pages.title: Cartoon Racing Car Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Compare two racing car pictures in Cartoon Racing Car Differences. Find seven differences before the minute is up, then take on the next pair of scenes. There are ten levels, each asking you to notice small changes in the artwork.

pages.title: Christmas Catcher
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Help Santa catch falling gift packages in Christmas Catcher. Move under the presents while avoiding pieces of the roof coming down with them. Watch both kinds of objects so you can get to a gift without collecting debris.

pages.title: Mathematical Skills
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Solve quick arithmetic questions in Mathematical Skills. You have three seconds to choose the correct answer, whether the problem asks you to add, subtract, multiply, or divide. Read the operation first so you can use the short time to calculate.

pages.title: Women Football Penalty Champions
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Step up to the penalty spot in Women Football Penalty Champions. Choose your moment and aim to send the ball into the goal in a tied match. Pay attention to the goalkeeper as you try to score for your side.

pages.title: Coloring HTML5 Studio
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a picture in Coloring HTML5 Studio and fill it with your own colors. Try one shade for the main parts and another for the smaller details. Switch to a new image when you want to work with a different palette.

pages.title: Annie Summer Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get Annie ready to host her summer party in Annie Summer Party. Choose makeup for the occasion and pick a dress that goes with it. Try different looks before deciding what she should wear for the weekend celebration.

pages.title: BFF Spring Fashion Show 2018
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare a contestant for the spring runway in BFF Spring Fashion Show 2018. Choose Elsa, Moana, or Barbie and put together her makeup and outfit. See how the look fares with Jack and Kristoff judging the show.

pages.title: Caveman Adventure
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Guide a caveman through short levels in Caveman Adventure. Use the items provided, including food and a chili pepper, to help him move through the scene. Watch what happens after each choice and work out how to get past the enemies.

pages.title: Halloween Doll Creator
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Create a character in Halloween Doll Creator. Pick the doll's eyes and hairstyle, then try Halloween clothes such as a dress or a shirt and pants. Finish the design with a face mask or paint to suit the costume.

pages.title: Color Stars
pages.creator: Cruzlutor
pages.description: Tap to change the color of the orbiting ball in Color Stars. Match the balls you encounter along the circuit while keeping clear of traps. Complete circuits to discover more planets and stars as the space-themed puzzles continue.

pages.title: Minion Wedding Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style the bride's hair in Minion Wedding Hairstyles. Start with the hairdressing session and use the tools to shape the bridal look. Choose a wedding dress to go with the hairstyle before the minion heads down the aisle.

pages.title: Princess Style Guide: Sporty Chic
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Try sporty chic looks with Snow White and Anna in Princess Style Guide: Sporty Chic. Use pastel makeup and choose simple, comfortable clothes for each princess. Compare how the colors and athletic pieces work together as you finish the two looks.

pages.title: Princess Match Accessory
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Match accessories to the outfits of Sofia, Amber, and Snow White in Princess Match Accessory. Look at what each princess is wearing before choosing an item to go with it. Earn points for matches and see how many looks you can complete.

pages.title: Fashion Designer H5
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Choose a dress shape in Fashion Designer H5, then change its color and pattern. Drag stickers or use the airbrush to add details to the garment. Try the same shape with another combination of colors and decorations to make a different design.

pages.title: Candy Thief
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Help a sweet-toothed thief gather candy in Candy Thief. Watch the ground ahead and move through the dangerous terrain to reach the sweets. Look for a route that lets you collect the candy while staying clear of trouble.

pages.title: Boyfriend Girly Makeover
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Give the boyfriend a makeover in Boyfriend Girly Makeover. Start with shaving and skin care, then choose a foundation shade and apply makeup with the tools provided. Build the look one step at a time and see how the different choices change his appearance.
